guard: A role-less agent credential carries no `$JS.API.STREAM.INFO` grant on DM, TASK, DLV or EPC, so it cannot read stream state or enumerate retained subjects on any per-peer stream.
proveWith: pnpm mutation-proof --config packages/core/smoke/mutations/read-acl-stream-info-scope.json   # --config resolves against the repo root, never the cwd
why: The agent profile emits a JetStream consumer-create DENY triple on DM, TASK and DLV, and for a
while it emitted no matching `$JS.API.STREAM.INFO` row for any of them. The first repair granted
STREAM.INFO on all four of DM, TASK, DLV and EPC, unconditionally, to every agent. That is wider
than the deny triple's shape suggests, because `subjects_filter` is a REQUEST-BODY field: no ACL
can split `STREAM.INFO` into 'message counts' and 'enumerate every retained subject'. A role-less
agent holding it on DM reads the whole DM social graph (who DMed whom, per-pair volume) and the
task-routing graph, on streams it has no other grant on at all.
The narrowed grammar: `STREAM.INFO.TASK` moved inside the existing `if (svcD)` role gate, next to
the `svc_<role>` bind rows it belongs with, and the DM/DLV/EPC rows removed outright (an agent
reaches DM and DLV through a pre-created durable by name and EPC through a subject-scoped
DIRECT.GET, so no agent-side caller reads any of them at stream level).
These mutations re-broaden the grant one stream at a time, so each deny cell is shown to measure
its OWN row rather than riding on a neighbour's. Re-broadening is the honest mutation here: it is
the exact code state the cells were reconciled against, so a cell that stays green under it is a
cell that would have blessed the wider grant.
This config grades the role-less side, which is the default agent shape and the one this suite
mints. The role-carrying side is graded from provision-stream-info-role-gate.json.

mutations.name: STREAM.INFO on the DM stream is granted to every agent again
mutations.expectRed: G1: STREAM.INFO on DM is blocked (no DM metadata leak)
mutations.cell: G1: STREAM.INFO on DM is blocked (no DM metadata leak)
mutations.note: The widest of the four. A `subjects_filter` query on DM_<space> enumerates `inst.<owner>.<actor>.<owner>.<actor>` with per-subject counts, which is the DM social graph; G1 is the cell that has to notice.

mutations.name: STREAM.INFO on the TASK stream escapes the role gate
mutations.expectRed: G2: STREAM.INFO on TASK is blocked
mutations.cell: G2: STREAM.INFO on TASK is blocked
mutations.note: Leaves the row inside `if (svcD)` alone and adds a second, ungated one, so what is mutated is the GATE rather than the grant. The agent this suite mints has no role and must still be refused.

mutations.name: STREAM.INFO on the delivery stream is granted to every agent again
mutations.expectRed: G3: STREAM.INFO on DLV is blocked (no delivery metadata leak)
mutations.cell: G3: STREAM.INFO on DLV is blocked (no delivery metadata leak)
mutations.note: DLV carries the re-authorized per-member handoff; enumerating its subjects names who has durable-backstop traffic pending.

mutations.name: STREAM.INFO on the EPC contract store is granted to every agent again
mutations.expectRed: G4: STREAM.INFO on EPC is blocked
mutations.cell: G4: STREAM.INFO on EPC is blocked
mutations.note: EPC is read by subject-scoped DIRECT.GET, so stream-level reach adds only the ability to list every contract subject in the space.
